people-ops: Org note  Samir Gupta is joining Redwood Inference as Director, Observability Platform, starting 2026-07-06. He'll lead the new Observability Platform squad focusing on alert reduction, unified tracing, and SLA dashboards. We'll reassign two PMs (PM-Run4 & PM-Obs2) into the new org and open one Sr Staff SWE and one Eng Manager backfill. Welcome Samir! :tada:

Aisha Patel: Big win  congrats Samir! Recruiting plan: internal-first referral window 4 business days, then external. I'll post req owners and job docs today.

Samir Gupta: Excited to join. First goals: 1) reduce noisy P1s by 30% in 90 days, 2) ship the cross-team SLA dashboard, 3) pilot a runbook-as-code initiative. I'll schedule short syncs with runtime and infra next week.

Diego Morales: Thanks Samir. We'll need a short customer note for key accounts about the observability roadmap. I'll draft and circulate for review.

Evan Carter: Headcount question  are the SWE/EM roles net-new or reorg? Need budget alignment for Q3 forecasts.

people-ops: Evan  Sr Staff SWE is a backfill (reallocated), Eng Manager is approved as a new slot for Q2 hiring. HC codes: ENG-OBS-501 (backfill), ENG-OBS-502 (new).

Priya Natarajan: For on-call impact  can we freeze rotation topology changes during Samir's first 3 weeks? We should avoid adding churn while new ownership is settling.

Samir Gupta: Agreed  propose freeze 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-26 except for critical fixes. I'll publish a handoff doc and an initial 30/60/90 plan by my first day.

HiringBot: Reminder: create Greenhouse openings with tag "observability-platform" and add interview rubrics. Deadline to create rubrics: 2026-05-20.

people-ops: ONBOARDING: https://redwood.company/onboarding/observability. Action items: Aisha to post reqs + owners; HiringBot to ping for rubrics; Samir to share 30/60/90 and handoff doc by 2026-07-06. Congrats Samir! :confetti_ball:
